{{Quote|She's hurt bad on the left of the tower. Concentrate on that side.|Wedge Antilles on the ''Pride of Tarlandia'' during the Battle of Endor|<ref name="ROTJn" />}}
The '''''Pride of Tarlandia''''' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] and [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]] that served as a [[communications ship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. As part of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During the battle, it served as the Empire's main communications ship and prevented the Alliance from detecting the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] that protected the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].

In the battle, it faced off against a Rebel [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and destroyed it, though the cruiser damaged the ''Pride of Tarlandia''. Because of the damage it sustained, Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], along with other Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], decided to launch an attack run on the ''Pride of Tarlandia'', and succeeded in destroying the vessel. The vessel's destruction enabled the Alliance to detect the Death Star's shield and caused the command of Death Squadron to fall to the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].

==Characteristics==
The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]]-classed<ref name="EGW" /> [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]] and [[communications ship]]<ref name="ROTJn" /> that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="EGW" /> It was one of the larger Destroyers present at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="ROTJn" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="EGW" /> The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' was equipped with several different sizes of [[Weapon/Legends|guns]], including front batteries and [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]. It possessed a tower, long axis, a [[Gunmetal/Legends|gunmetal]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]], and [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]] positioned just inside its cargo bay.<ref name="ROTJn" /> It shared its name with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Tarlandia system/Legends|Tarlandia system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Starting attack run on the main power tree.|Lando Calrissian beginning his attack run on the ''Pride of Tarlandia''|<ref name="ROTJn" />}}
[[File:BattleofEndor.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' participated in the Battle of Endor (conflict pictured).]]
In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="EGW" /> as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Alliance was lured to<ref name="ROTJn" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], where [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had laid a trap for the Alliance in hopes of destroying it. A member of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]],<ref name="EGW" /> the ''Pride of Tarlandia'' fought in the Battle of Endor, where it was the main communications [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by the Imperial fleet, [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] the Alliance's scanners and thus preventing them from detecting the status of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' went into a rough battle with a Rebel [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and emerged victorious, destroying the other ship. It suffered reparable damage during its encounter, and because of the damage it had sustained, Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] decided to attempt a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] run against it while it was still vulnerable.<ref name="ROTJn" />

Calrissian's [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]<ref name="ROTJn" /> [[Merrick Simms]],<ref name="AGttSWU3">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> and [[Green Wing]] began their attack run against the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]]. They went in low enough to avoid the ''Pride of Tarlandia''{{'s}} bigger guns, performed a high-speed power-dive perpendicular to the ship's long axis, and raced along the hull while under heavy fire. Green Wing was hit and crashed into the front batteries on the port side of the vessel, allowing the other fighters a chance to hit the power reactors located inside a cargo bay.<ref name="ROTJn" />

Pulling out of the bay after a heavy strike, the surviving Rebel fighters escaped as the ship was destroyed in a series of increasing explosions, with one of the explosions killing Simms and destroying a nearby Imperial ship. The ''Pride of Tarlandia''{{'s}} destruction greatly hampered the operations of the rest of the fleet and caused the scanner jamming of the Rebel fleet to stop, allowing them to detect the status of the Death Star II's operational [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator.<ref name="ROTJn" /> The Battle of Endor resulted in a victory for the Alliance, with the Death Star II and a large portion of the Imperial fleet being destroyed.<ref name="EGW" /> Because of both the ''Pride of Tarlandia''{{'s}} destruction and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor''{{'s}}]] eventual destruction, command of Death Squadron fell to<ref name="EGW" /> the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], the next communications ship in line.<ref name="EGW" />

==Crew==
The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' possessed a crew that included reactor personnel. Its reactor personnel were surprised and horrified when Calrissian pulled the ''Falcon'' into a sharp bank to destroy the ship's reactors.<ref name="ROTJn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' originated in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which was written by [[James Kahn]] and published on<ref name="ROTJn" /> [[May 12]], [[1983]], before the film's release on [[May 25]] of that same year.<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Although it was not identified in the novel,<ref name="ROTJn" /> the vessel was identified as the ''Pride of Tarlandia'' in the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and published in [[2012]].<ref name="EGW" />
